desc: Store, protect, and transport your gear with the black, crushproof, dustproof, weather-resistant Vault V550 Standard Equipment Case with Foam Insert from Pelican. The Vault line of cases features a multi-layer foam insert for organizing gear, purge vent, heavy-duty ergonomic handle, and high-impact polymer construction. Users will appreciate the easy-open push-button latches and stainless steel lock hasps.
